notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Please go to an emergency department now; call 911 instead if you faint, become confused, or cannot get there safely. Your severe cramping pain, bloated abdomen, vomiting and no bowel movement for three days need urgent hands-on examination, scans and blood tests. Do not wait for a reply here. I recommend a Counsel clinician follow up in this thread afterwards.
